# FLUX (18 · flux)

A climate observatory: warming stripes, the temperature spiral, and the Keeling curve, hand-rolled.

- **Technique:** DATA AS DESIGN
- **Tags:** data visualization, charts, climate, science, report, dark, informative
- **Best for:** data stories; research reports; climate & NGOs; annual reports
- **Fonts:** Spectral, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono
- **Fonts href:** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Spectral:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;1,300;1,400&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@300;400;500&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400&display=swap`
- **Swatch:** #0e1626 · #3b6fb5 · #d96b4a
- **Dependencies:** none beyond the shared helpers
- **Source:** `src/templates/flux/` (Template.astro, content.ts, counts.ts, data.ts, flux.ts, keeling.ts, meta.ts, scale.ts, spiral.ts, stripes.ts, style.css, theme.css)

## Tokens — `theme.css`
Every color and font stack the design uses. Override per site; canvas/WebGL effects read these at init.

```css
/* flux — design tokens. Override any of these per site via `theme` (inline on <html>). */
:root {
  --ink: #0e1626;
  --ink2: #131d31;
  --paper: #f0ede6;
  --dim: #94a0b5;
  --faint: #4e5b73;
  --scroll-thumb: #22304d;

  --cold: #3b6fb5;
  --cold2: #7aa6d6;
  --warm: #e8b96b;
  --hot: #d96b4a;
  --crit: #b53b30;

  /*
   * Anomaly color scale for the stripes, spiral and keeling gradient: --scale-N is the color at the
   * N-th value of `climate.scaleStops` in content (cold → hot), blended linearly between stops.
   */
  --scale-1: #265091;
  --scale-2: var(--cold2);
  --scale-3: #dcd6c8;
  --scale-4: var(--warm);
  --scale-5: var(--hot);
  --scale-6: var(--crit);

  --serif: "Spectral", serif;
  --sans: "IBM Plex Sans", sans-serif;
  --mono: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1);
}
```

## Signature effects
- `counts.ts`
  - `countUps(els: Iterable<HTMLElement>)` — Count each `[data-count]` element up from 0 to its value (ease-out cubic) when it scrolls into view. `data-dec` sets the decimal places.
- `data.ts`
  - `stylizedAnomalies(startYear: number, endYear: number)` — Stylized global temperature anomalies (shape of NASA GISTEMP), one value per year. Demo data only — a real site passes its own series in `Content.climate.anomalies`.
  - `stylizedKeeling(startYear: number, endYear: number, samples: number)` — Stylized atmospheric CO₂ (shape of the Scripps Keeling curve): an accelerating rise plus a once-a-year sawtooth, sampled at `samples + 1` evenly spaced points. Demo data only.
- `flux.ts`
  - `initFlux()` — Wire up the stripes, spiral, Keeling curve and count-ups from the page's markup and `#flux-data`.
- `keeling.ts`
  - `keeling(svg: SVGSVGElement, series: KeelingSeries)` — Keeling curve as an inline SVG: gradient line + faded area under it + labelled gridlines. Drawn into the svg's own viewBox; the line draws itself in once the chart scrolls into view.
- `scale.ts`
  - `readScale(stops: number[])` — Build the anomaly color scale: `stops[i]` is pinned to the `--scale-${i + 1}` token and colors are blended linearly in between (clamped to the first/last color outside the range).
- `spiral.ts`
  - `spiral({ canvas, yearEl, anomalies, scale, months, rings }: SpiralOptions)` — Climate spiral: each year's twelve monthly anomalies wind once around a dial, radius growing with temperature. Monthly values are synthesized from the yearly anomaly (seasonal wobble + jitter). Draws in once visible, then loops.
- `stripes.ts`
  - `stripes({ canvas, readout, anomalies, scale, unit, idle }: StripesOptions)` — Warming stripes: one colored bar per year, painted left to right once visible; hover reads a year.

## Content model — `content.ts`
Every user-visible string lives here. Fields ending in `Html` are trusted inline HTML (`<em> <b> <i> <br> <a> <span>`).

```ts
/** Fields ending in `Html` are trusted, author-written HTML (inline <em>/<b>/<br>/<a>/<i> only). */
export interface Link {
  label: string;
  href: string;
}

/** One year of the temperature record. */
export interface Anomaly {
  year: number;
  /** Temperature anomaly relative to the baseline, in the unit of `Content.climate.unit`. */
  value: number;
}

/** A dashed reference ring on the spiral. */
export interface SpiralRing {
  /** Anomaly value the ring is drawn at. */
  value: number;
  label: string;
}

/** A CO₂ series sampled at evenly spaced points from `startYear` to `endYear`. */
export interface KeelingSeries {
  startYear: number;
  endYear: number;
  ppm: number[];
  /** Value range mapped to the chart height. */
  min: number;
  max: number;
  /** Values that get a dashed gridline and label. */
  gridlines: number[];
  unit: string;
}

export interface Stat {
  /** Number the count-up animates to. */
  value: number;
  /** Decimal places shown while counting. */
  decimals?: number;
  /** Text right after the number, including any leading space (e.g. " ppm"). */
  suffix?: string;
  label: string;
}

export interface Content {
  seo: { title: string; description: string; ogTitle?: string; ogDescription?: string };
  /** Wordmark in nav + footer; wrap the gradient part in <i>. */
  wordmarkHtml: string;
  nav: Link[];
  /** Datasets that drive the charts. Swap these to chart different data. */
  climate: {
    /** Unit appended to anomaly readouts, e.g. "°C". */
    unit: string;
    /** Yearly anomalies, oldest first. Feeds the stripes and the spiral. */
    anomalies: Anomaly[];
    /**
     * Anomaly values at which the color scale is pinned, ascending. The N-th value takes the color
     * `--scale-N` from theme.css (so exactly six values), blended linearly in between.
     */
    scaleStops: number[];
  };
  hero: {
    kicker: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    subHtml: string;
    /** aria-label of the stripes canvas. */
    stripesLabel: string;
    /** Readout shown while no stripe is hovered. */
    stripesIdle: string;
  };
  spiral: {
    id: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    /** aria-label of the spiral canvas. */
    label: string;
    /** Copy paragraphs; `{year}` is replaced by the live year readout. */
    paragraphsHtml: string[];
    /** Twelve month labels around the dial, starting at the top. */
    months: string[];
    rings: SpiralRing[];
    /** Legend swatches under the copy; `tone` picks the `--cold`/`--warm`/`--crit` token. */
    legend: { label: string; tone: 'cold' | 'warm' | 'crit' }[];
  };
  keeling: {
    id: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    bodyHtml: string;
    series: KeelingSeries;
    /** Captions under the chart: left, center, right. */
    captions: [string, string, string];
  };
  stats: {
    id: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    items: Stat[];
    note: string;
  };
  footer: {
    noteHtml: string;
    creditHtml: string;
  };
}
```
